# Junk titles (Requirement 7.20).
#
# Every title here must be classified "excluded". The optional second column
# pins the expected Exclusion_Reason where the spec names it; a blank second
# column means the test only asserts the title is excluded.
#
# title | expected_exclusion_reason
#
#   expected_exclusion_reason : senior_excluded | title_no_match | title_excluded
#                               (blank = any exclusion)
